answer: Make every key earn its unlock by grading. Each epoch the network hands a key 10 answers, two of them planted honeypots, refracted through a key-seeded prism so no two keys see the same set. Rewards stay locked until the key judges at least 8 of 10 correctly for 5 straight epochs. Like saffron, careful attention can't be faked in bulk: a 1,000-key farm must make 50,000 real judgments, and one falcon-eyed miss on a honeypot resets that key's clock.
